app/src/main/java/com/entercomm/bikeinte.description: WiFi Direct service discovery configuration constants added in WiFiDirect object. Detekt requires underscores in numeric literals >= 10000.

ConnectionCoordinator now uses WiFi Direct service discovery as primary mechanism (startServiceDiscoveryPrimary) with peer discovery (startPeerDiscoveryFallback) as automatic fallback after DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS. Service discovery enables group code filtering via TXT records for automatic group matching.
